claim_scope: Exact official-notice excerpt exploratory abstention audit for the original NL_ocean schema; broader factual candidate annotation is a separate task.
selection_method: Purposive assistant selection from the existing 13-source registry plus three official quantitative notices; not a random or representative sample.
independence_warning: Sources, announcements, operational event groups and correlation groups are not interchangeable independent samples. All records are exploratory; shared wider disruptions can cross declared correlation groups.
split_policy: One exploratory test collection. No development partition, frozen holdout or generalization inference. Keep amendments, translations and operational updates together in any future split.
text_policy: Sources.text and model_input.text are identical exact <=25-word body excerpts. Titles and other provenance metadata are not inference input. Full readable article bodies were reviewed but are not redistributed; full-article replay is unavailable. Hashes cover exact excerpts only. Assistant paraphrases are separate audit material, never original text or model input.
broader_task_policy: annotation.broad_reference is draft factual extraction from model_input.text only. Full-page-only facts occur solely in source_review.json and are not labels for these inputs. The broader task uses calendar dates, day ranges, averages, event types and availability changes; it is not the original integer-week add_lead task. No broad model score or human-gold claim is reported.
